methodology.api_definition: Public weather/geocode paths and exact six-digit version prefixes; exclude health checks, non-product version prefixes, static files and other paths.
methodology.date_time: CloudFront response completion timestamp, UTC; start inclusive, end exclusive
methodology.user_agent_heuristic: Android-like: android or okhttp; Apple-like: iphone, ipad, cfnetwork, darwin or ios; remaining bot/tool signatures, browser signatures or unknown. No verified app identity.

gateway_routes_last_7_days.query:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /HTTP Method: /
| parse @message /HTTP Method: (?<method>[^,]+), Resource Path: (?<path>[^\s]+)/
| parse path /^\/(?<service>weather|geocode)\/(?:(?<version>v\d+)\/)?(?<kind>coord|addr)(?:\/|$)/
| stats count(*) as calls, min(@timestamp) as first_seen, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by bin(1d) as day, method, service, version, kind
| sort day asc, calls desc

gateway_status_last_7_days.query:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /Method completed with status: /
| parse @message /Method completed with status: (?<status>\d+)/
| stats count(*) as completions, min(@timestamp) as first_seen, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by bin(1d) as day, status
| sort day asc, status asc
